# Quasar matmul block tests use DataflowBuffers, but `build_kernel_defines`
# in tt-metal's emulated_program_runner.cpp only emits EMULE_CB_DATA_FORMATS
# from `circular_buffers_on_core` — DFB slots stay `Invalid`. With the
# page-size heuristic gone (PR #140), `pack_tile` falls into the bf16 branch
# when fp32_dest_acc_en=true, corrupting output. Unblock by extending the
# runner to also emit DFB formats.
